name: How do I choose the best flooring type for high-traffic areas?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best flooring type for high-traffic areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: For high-traffic areas, durability and ease of maintenance are key considerations. Excellent choices include luxury vinyl plank (LVP), porcelain or ceramic tile, and certain types of engineered hardwood. LVP is highly resilient, waterproof, and scratch-resistant, making it ideal for busy entryways and family rooms. Tile is incredibly hard-wearing, water-resistant, and simple to clean, perfect for kitchens and hallways. Engineered hardwood, especially those with harder wood species and durable finishes, can also withstand significant foot traffic. Carpet is generally not recommended for very high-traffic zones due to wear and staining.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose durable, easy-to-maintain options like luxury vinyl plank (LVP), porcelain/ceramic tile, or robust engineered hardwood for high-traffic areas. Carpet is not typically recommended.
